title: On the variation and asymptotics of maximal functions
summary: In this paper we present partial progress towards two conjectures on the variation of maximal operators of convolution type $\mathrm{M}_{\varphi}$, associated to non-negative and radial decreasing kernels $\varphi$ of integral $1$. In dimension $d=1$ we prove that $\mathrm{var}(\mathrm{M}_{\varphi} f) \leq \mathrm{var}(f)$ when $f$ is a characteristic function. In higher dimensions we prove that $\mathrm{var}(\mathrm{M}_{\varphi} f) \leq C_d \mathrm{var}(f)$ when $f$ is a radial characteristic function, with a constant $C_d$ depending only on the dimension $d$ but not on the kernel…
